name: Egor
tagline: Go & TypeScript backends, AI desktop apps and
Telegram platforms — from first commit to production.

now.name: Unvara
now.text: Private AI that runs on your own computer: local LLMs picked for your hardware, a chat and a coding agent.

projects.name: Unvara
projects.text: Desktop app for local LLMs: hardware scan and model fitting, resumable downloads, a signed model catalog, CUDA / Vulkan llama.cpp engine provisioning, MCP connectors, auto-updates.

projects.name: shutdown.fyi
projects.text: Live tracker of internet outages in Russia: 38 services, 8 operators, 85 regions. DNS → TCP → TLS → HTTP probes every 5 min, OONI / IODA / Radar ingest, AI summaries, open API.

projects.name: ThaiCarRental
projects.text: Car and bike rental marketplace for Thailand with a CRM for suppliers: geo search on PostGIS, background jobs, typed API from a declarative schema.

projects.name: Biletoff
projects.text: Finds abnormally cheap flights by comparing live fares with each route's baseline, and publishes them to a server-rendered site, a Telegram channel and a bot.

projects.name: FlowForge
projects.text: Zapier / n8n-style automation platform: drag-and-drop workflow editor, webhook, cron, email and Telegram triggers, BullMQ queues, real-time notifications.

projects.name: TaskFlow
projects.text: Team task management SaaS: roles, Kanban with drag and drop, task dependencies, voice-to-task with speech recognition, analytics and deadline notifications.
